TwoFactor.setupIntro: Staff accounts must use two-step verification. Scan this QR code with an authenticator app (for example Google Authenticator or Microsoft Authenticator), then enter the 6-digit code it shows.

ResetPassword.title: Choose a new password

ResetPassword.done: Your password has been changed. You can now sign in.
ResetPassword.missingToken: This link is incomplete. Please use the full link from the email, or request a new one.

ProgramCard.practicalStage: Includes a practical stage at a company

hero.title: Start your path into high tech, one clear step at a time
hero.body: Professional programs with a real company stage, one-to-one mentoring with an instructor, and advice from people working in tech today, all in one platform.
hero.note: No payment to enroll · An advisor calls you about price and installments

topPrograms.title: Our top programs
topPrograms.description: Three professional programs built around AI. Each one includes a practical stage working on a real company product.

ways.title: Three ways to learn with us
ways.description: Choose what fits your time and goals, or combine them.

live.title: Live courses
live.body: Online meetings on a fixed schedule with a teacher and a group, live Q&A and weekly projects.

mentoring.title: Teacher mentoring
mentoring.body: A package of one-to-one meetings — such as 8 — for help with lessons and a practical project.

career.title: Career advice
career.body: A session with a tech professional: choosing a direction, CV or portfolio review, or interview preparation.

choose.title: Choose your path
choose.body: Browse programs, or book career advice to find the right starting point.

enroll.title: Enroll
enroll.body: Leave your details. An advisor calls you to go over the program, price and installments — no payment now.

learn.title: Learn and practice
learn.body: Join live classes or watch recordings, and complete hands-on projects with your instructor’s guidance.

career.title: Get ready for work
career.body: Prepare your CV and portfolio, and practice interviews with professionals.

stories.title: Graduate stories
stories.description: Experiences in our graduates’ own words, shared with their written consent.

instructors.title: Meet your instructors
instructors.description: The people who teach the programs, mentor students one-to-one and stay with them until the practical stage.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.description: Didn’t find your answer? The support team replies to your messages inside the platform.

closing.title: Not sure where to start?
closing.body: Book a career advice session with a tech professional and we’ll help you choose the right path.

Catalog.title: Course catalog
Catalog.intro: Live programs on a fixed schedule, each with a practical stage at a partner company. Use the filters to find the right place to start.
Catalog.subject: Subject
Catalog.emptyBody: Try another subject or level, or clear the filters.

careerBox.title: Not sure which level fits?
careerBox.body: Book a short career advice session and we’ll suggest where to start.

Enroll.title: Enroll — book a call with us
Enroll.intro: Leave your details and the times that suit you. An academy advisor will call you back to answer your questions and complete your enrollment.
Enroll.whenIntro: Choose the days and the times you are usually free. We’ll call within those hours.
Enroll.notesPlaceholder: e.g. I prefer to talk in Arabic, or I have a question about installments.
Enroll.privacy: We use these details only to contact you about the program.

next.title: What happens next
next.step1: at one of the times you chose, usually within 24 hours.
next.step2: the program, schedule, the practical stage, price and installments.
next.step3: and register — no payment is taken on this website.

thanks.title: Thank you, {firstName}!
thanks.body: We received your details. An advisor will call you at one of the times you chose.
